# Switch NX2 Performance Tuning - Optimized for Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2)
# Environment: RTX 5060 + Intel Core i9-11900RH

# 1. Thread Splitting (Offload GPU methods to back thread, up to +54% FPS)
EDEN_NX2_SPLIT=2

# 2. Batch GPU fences to reduce driver latency
EDEN_NX2_FENCE_BATCH=1

# 3. Cap GPU-written SSBO mark (Stops 240+ MB/s of PCIe fence download flood on Kokiri Forest vegetation)
EDEN_NX2_WRITTEN_SSBO_MARK_KIB=128

# 4. Turing MME Macro JIT compiler enabled
EDEN_NX2_MME_JIT=1

# 5. Cap ASTC transcode threads to prevent CPU core starvation
EDEN_NX2_TRANSCODE_THREADS=4

# 6. Fog, Atmosphere & Pipeline Corrections (Fixes overblown white bloom / washed-out fog)
EDEN_NX2_A2C_REFRESH=1
EDEN_NX2_MESH_FIRST=1
EDEN_NX2_OOT_VISUAL_WORKAROUND=1

# 7. DLSS / Streamline Hardware Upscaling
EDEN_NX2_DLSS_REPLACEMENT=dlss
EDEN_NX2_DLSS_PRESET=default
EDEN_NX2_DLSS_HDR=0
EDEN_NX2_DLSS_AUTO_EXPOSURE=0

# 8. Force FSR3 Frame Generation 2x on startup
EDEN_NX2_FRAME_GEN=1

# 9. Preload ALL cached disk pipelines at startup so zero cached shaders stall during gameplay
EDEN_NX2_PRELOAD_ALL_PIPELINES=1

# 10. Non-blocking asynchronous shader compilation (prevents 0 FPS freezes on new shaders)
EDEN_NX2_ASYNC_DISCARD=1
